note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named. RFC 2918 Section 4: "Otherwise, the BGP speaker shall re- advertise to that peer the Adj-RIB-Out of the <AFI, SAFI> carried in the message, based on its outbound route filtering policy." ff89fc8110 (a withdraw verdict withdraws both families) changed only the egressRouteFilter closure in the tagged unit to the new three-value signature (suppress, override, follow); session_write.go writeUpdateGated and the raw-forward path read the first two exactly as before and the follow body is nil in this unit, so every input and every assertion is unchanged. TestRFC2918RefreshRunsCurrentExportPolicy still requires one policy call and grown wire output on an accepting replay, and identical wire bytes with a second call once only the policy answer flips to reject, so the outbound policy decides the re-advertisement in both polarities. Other carriers byte-identical. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
